annotations.title: Upload a screenshot or preview to a custom product page or A/B test treatment

description: Uploads one file from an absolute path on this machine to a custom product page's language (owner page, parentId the page ID) or an A/B test treatment's language (owner test, parentId the test ID), by the localizationId ploa_marketing_get shows for the page or test. kind screenshot: PNG or JPEG up to 10 MB, type an App Store display type such as APP_IPHONE_67 or APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129. kind preview: an app preview video (MOV, M4V or MP4; H.264, 15 to 30 seconds, at most 30 fps and 500 MB, in the device size's resolution, checked before anything is sent), type such as IPHONE_67 or IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129, up to 3 per device size. Only while the page's version or the test is being prepared. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
